{{DISPLAYTITLE:Official Screenshots of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''}}
This article covers '''official screenshots''' released for {{SA}}.
__TOC__

With the release of the [[GTASanAndreas.com|promotional website]] for ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'' in 2004, 19 official screenshots of the [[PlayStation 2]] version were made available in the "Screens" section. The website also included a Flash version of a interactive map of the state of [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]] with points of interest. Each point of interest included an in-universe [[San Andreas Police Department (3D Universe)|San Andreas State Patrol]] description of the area and exclusive meterial (screenshots, videos and audio).

Two subsites of the promotional website created to promote the [[Xbox]] and [[Personal Computer|PC]] versions of the game also provided 10 new screenshots for each new version of the title.
